newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's REE details compensation from France's EdF.
newsitem.headline: Spain's REE details compensation from France's EdF.

text.p: Spain's publicly controlled electrical group Red Electrica de Espana (REE) reiterated on Wednesday it would be compensated with 300 bln pesetas from Electricite de France (EdF) for breach of contract.
This came after France's EdF utility said that it will pay Red Electrica de Espana only 30 billion pesetas.

REE, which monitors Spain's high-tension electrical network, said that EdF will pay only 1.3 million French francs (some 27 billion pesetas) but added that the deal also stipulates reductions in energy supply costs and lower fixed costs.
REE said it expected to save a total of 270.2 billion pesetas in reduced expenditures and costs. It estimated savings from the lower cost of French energy would be around 52.61 billion pesetas.

In 1990, EdF agreed to connect the French electrical network to the Spanish and provide 1,000 megawatts of electricity a year. But France later disallowed the construction because it would have hurt a sensitive ecological area.
